                           PMEG2010AEH
                           20 V, 1 A very low VF Schottky barrier rectifier
                           8 October 2024                                                           Product data sheet




1. General description
                       Planar Schottky barrier rectifier with an integrated guard ring for stress protection, encapsulated in
                       a small SOD123F Surface-Mounted Device (SMD) plastic package.


2. Features and benefits
                       •   Forward current: IF ≤ 1 A
                       •   Reverse voltage: VR ≤ 20 V
                       •   Very low forward voltage
                       •   Small SMD plastic packages


3. Applications
                       •   Low voltage rectification
                       •   High efficiency DC-to-DC conversion
                       •   Switch mode power supply
                       •   Reverse polarity protection
                       •   Low power consumption applications
